name: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Gas Refill Yojana
benefit: Under this scheme, Antyodaya ration card (pink card) holders in the state are entitled to receive 03 free gas cylinder refills every year.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must hold an Antyodaya (pink card) ration card issued by the state.
